notes.title: Hotfix, edge collision
notes.notes: Hotfix for paddle overlapping level edge resulting in paddle being unable to move.

notes.title: Minor Update to UI and controls
notes.notes:
Some minor update.

Adjustments to timing of end game UI elements.
Space-bar added to primary attack. W added to secondary attack.
Minor changes to high score display. High score switched to mono spaced font.
Slight adjustments to placement of bricks in game levels and level editor to correct brick alignement.

notes.title: Bug fix to level editor.
notes.notes: Bug fix for level editor not creating custom map directory.

notes.title: Update to level editor
notes.notes: Level editor is mostly functional now. It's not pretty, but it's working. I'll clean it up soon.

notes.title: Minor Update - Level editor packaged in current build
notes.notes:
Added transition effect when new levels are created.

Added a very early and rough version of the level editor that will be packaged with the final game.

Some other minor changes.
